name: xmake-no-standard
description: 0.0.8 part 2 X-3, X-7 (the xmake bundle of 2026-09-30, E4): an xmake project that never says set_languages, built by GCC 16, whose main.cpp imports std -- no module file, so xmake's commands name no standard at all. Clang's own gnu++17 could not even scan libstdc++'s std.cc (20 errors) and preparation waited on it. Module units whose build names no standard are read as C++23, the standard `import std` is for, and the report says it was mcppls's choice; std::println, which C++20 does not have, is found. (With a module file, xmake itself adds -std=c++20, and that is followed.)
